title: Universal Animation Library 2
summary: 42 more humanoid clips by Quaternius: sword and shield combos, climbing, sliding, ninja jumps, throwing, farming, chopping, carrying, zombie moves; retargeted like universal-animation-library.
useWhen: Humanoid 3D characters need actions beyond walking and running: melee combos, shield blocks, parkour (climb, slide, jumps), work animations such as farming and chopping, carrying, or zombie movement.
avoidWhen: The game needs only idle, walk, run, and jump clips, which universal-animation-library has, or its characters are not humanoid.
copyright: Animations by Quaternius; the import settings, bone maps, and retarget.gd that WASD Engine adds are also CC0-1.0
